name: Pseudonymise ID columns of a table
description: Replaces ID columns of a CSV file (account numbers, PAN, mobile, customer IDs...) with tokens, for sharing with people who don't need the real IDs. The result is pseudonymised, not anonymous: equal IDs get equal tokens (so totals and joins still work, and so does counting how often an ID appears), and the other columns are unchanged. Use a domain per purpose (e.g. customer_account:v1) so tables made for different purposes can't be linked. The originals are kept encrypted in the vault; only the key in Windows Credential Manager can turn tokens back (template 'Restore pseudonymised columns'). Back up the key with `autoflow secret show pseudonym_key`.
